item.description:
Linkin Park - Somewhere I Belong [Live in São Paulo] (2160p 4K)​


​
Live performance of 'Somewhere I Belong' in São Paulo to promote their upcoming documentary concert film, UNSHATTER. The film follows their journey through loss, resilience and creative reinvention. From studio sessions in 2022 to a sold out FROM ZERO album release show in São Paulo, this is the story of how they started over. Directed by Joe Hahn. Experience UNSHATTER in theaters worldwide for a limited run beginning September 30. The UNSHATTER Film Soundtrack (Live in São Paulo) is out September 25, featuring career-spanning live tracks recorded at our FROM ZERO album release show in November 2024.
